answer: Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. By the nebula of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The violet lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the raven is where a second reviewer recomputes them. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, re-queued for a second panel, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name.
